title: Former Army boss Dan Driscoll joins OpenAI as senior counselor
summary: In his new role, Driscoll will “work with OpenAI teams and leaders across governments, industry, academia, and allied institutions to advance practical modernization initiatives that support the buildout of democratic AI,” the company said in a press release announcing his appointment. The post Former Army boss Dan Driscoll joins OpenAI as senior counselor appeared first on DefenseScoop .
